root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph CLI wrapper and capability contract
root_causes.description: The project lacks an integration layer to reproducibly invoke the Infigraph CLI. There is no way to perform analysis using Infigraph while guaranteeing that the environment has the correct, pinned version and the required capabilities.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new wrapper module `scripts/kb/infigraph.py` to handle the reproducible Infigraph runtime.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
